question: A long straight wire carries a steady current $I$. A rectangular loop of length $L$ (parallel to the wire) and width $w$ is placed in the same plane as the wire such that the nearer side of the loop is at a distance $d$ from the wire and the farther side is at a distance $d+w$. The loop moves directly away from the wire with constant speed $v$ (so $d$ increases at the rate $\dot d=v$). Find the magnitude of the rate of change of magnetic flux through the loop, $\left|\frac{d\Phi}{dt}\right|$ (hence the magnitude of induced emf $|\varepsilon|$).
